final_answer:
CLOSING CHECKLIST vs. APA — DEVIATION REPORT (Saxonbrook/Cascade; APA 3/14/2025; checklist 4/28/2025; Closing 5/15/2025)

BOTTOM LINE
The checklist cannot be used as the closing roadmap. It misstates the core economics (Escrow, Closing Cash Payment, Holdback %, Cap, Escrow Period, Outside Date), omits four Buyer-condition items (Northwind consent, FIRPTA certificate, estoppels, title commitments), shortens the Non-Compete and extends the NWC statement deadline, and cites wrong sections throughout. Checklist Part VIII says the APA controls; correct each item to the APA unless an 11.5 amendment exists (none supplied). Severity: CRITICAL = wrong money/rights or missing closing condition; HIGH = wrong deadline/term or missing deliverable; MEDIUM = incomplete/inaccurate description; LOW = cross-reference/style.

A. ECONOMIC TERMS
A1 CRITICAL Escrow Amount: checklist $5,500,000 (Part I, P-5, B-1, B-4, PC-3); APA $5,250,000 (1.1, 2.5(b)(ii), 8.2(b), 9.5; Ex. F). Wrong wire to Pinnacle and wrong figure in Escrow Agreement. Fix to $5.25M.
A2 CRITICAL Closing Cash Payment: checklist $78,500,000; APA $78,750,000 (1.1, 2.5(b)(i), 8.2(a)). Seller would be underpaid $250,000, breaching 8.2(a) and failing Seller's 7.2(c). Totals coincide ($84.0M), masking the error. Fix.
A3 HIGH Holdback: amount matches ($3.5M) but checklist says 5%; APA says 4% (1.1, 2.5(b)(iii)). Correct percentage.
A4 CRITICAL General Indemnification Cap: checklist $8,500,000 "approximately 10%" (Part I, PC-7); APA $8,750,000 = 10% (1.1, 9.4(c)). Understates Buyer's recovery by $250,000; fix before docketing.
A5 CRITICAL Escrow Period: checklist 24 months, release about 5/15/2027 (Part I, B-4, PC-3, Key Dates); APA 18 months, expiring 11/15/2026 (1.1, 9.5, Ex. F). Wrong release docket; Escrow Agreement drafted from checklist would over-hold funds. Fix; note it now coincides with the 18-month general survival date, so claim notices must be delivered to the Escrow Agent before 11/15/2026 (9.5).
A6 HIGH NWC De Minimis Collar omitted: checklist (Part I, P-4, PC-1) says any deviation adjusts dollar-for-dollar; APA 2.6(a), 2.6(d) apply a $150,000 collar (no adjustment if deviation is at or below $150,000; if above, the full amount, not just the excess, adjusts). Add collar to P-4/PC-1.
A7 HIGH Estimated NWC adjusts the Closing Cash Payment at Closing (2.6(a)) if the estimate misses Target NWC ($6.8M) by more than $150,000; checklist funds flow (P-5, B-1) hard-codes $78.5M and ignores this. Funds flow must be built after the Estimated Closing Statement (due 3 Business Days pre-Closing, i.e., 5/12/2025), leaving about one Business Day before the funds flow due date (2 Business Days = 5/13).
A8 MEDIUM Reverse Break-Up Fee: amount and 3% correct ($2,625,000). Trigger mis-cited: checklist says Seller termination under "9.1(d)"; APA 10.3 applies on Seller termination under 10.1(e) when Buyer fails to close with conditions satisfied; fee payable within 5 Business Days. Fix cite.
A9 MEDIUM Payoff funds flow: checklist P-5 lists a Summit Ridge wire (about $14.3M) but B-1 totals only $84.0M and APA 2.5(b)/8.2 do not say payoff comes from Seller's proceeds. Confirm payoff is deducted from Seller's Closing Cash Payment (and Ridgeline fees, Excluded Liability under 4.14) via a written direction letter; otherwise Buyer pays above Purchase Price.
A10 MEDIUM Wire timing: APA 2.5(b)(i)/8.2(a) require Seller to designate its account in writing at least 2 Business Days before Closing (5/13/2025); checklist lacks this item.

B. DATES AND DEADLINES
B1 CRITICAL Outside Date: checklist 7/14/2025 (Part I, Key Dates); APA 8/14/2025 (1.1, 10.1(b)). Checklist also cites "9.1(b)"; Article IX is Indemnification, termination is 10.1(b). Fix date and cite.
B2 CRITICAL Proposed Final Closing Statement: checklist Buyer has 90 days (8/13/2025) (PC-1, Key Dates); APA 2.6(b) gives 60 days (7/14/2025). Buyer's own deadline is missed by 30 days if docketed per checklist, risking breach and loss of control of the true-up. Re-docket 7/14/2025.
B3 HIGH Dispute path incomplete: checklist (PC-1) omits the 15-day Resolution Period, Accounting Firm (30 days to decide, fees split equally, binding absent manifest error) and deemed acceptance if no Dispute Notice in 30 days (2.6(c)); also payment within 5 Business Days (2.6(e)). Add.
B4 HIGH Holdback release: checklist PC-1/PC-2 say 90 days after final determination, citing 2.6(d); APA 2.5(b)(iii) says 90 days, but 2.6(e) says release simultaneously with the adjustment payment within 5 Business Days. APA is internally inconsistent (unresolved); checklist should cite 2.5(b)(iii)/2.6(e), flag conflict, and recommend a clarifying amendment (11.5) or conservative 5-Business-Day docket. Payment mechanics are 2.6(e), not 2.6(d) (which is the adjustment formula).
B5 HIGH Employee offers: APA 6.8(a) requires Buyer to offer employment to at least 108 of 127 (85%) no later than 15 days pre-Closing = 4/30/2025; checklist P-7 targets 10 Business Days pre-Closing (about 5/1/2025) - one day late and, with the checklist dated 4/28, two days from the actual deadline while status is "In Progress". Accelerate immediately.
B6 MEDIUM UCC-3 timing: checklist PC-4 imposes 10 Business Days (about 5/30/2025); APA 8.1(i) requires release evidence "at or promptly following" Closing, so the payoff letter should commit to filing at or on Closing.
B7 LOW Regenerate Key Dates table: Final Statement 7/14, Escrow release 11/15/2026, Non-Compete expiry 5/15/2029, Outside Date 8/14; add account designation (5/13) and allocation (G1).

C. CLOSING CONDITIONS AND CONSENTS
C1 CRITICAL Northwind Aerospace consent missing: APA 7.1(d)(iii), Sched. 7.1(d) item 3 (Supply Agreement 4/12/2021, anti-assignment, s. 12.3, "material commercial relationship," condition to Closing) and 8.1(j). Checklist P-2/S-9 list only Summit Ridge, Crestline, Burnham and HSR. Without it, Buyer's closing condition fails; Buyer can waive only in writing; 6.4 alternative-arrangement fallback applies. Add and start outreach now.
C2 HIGH Summit Ridge consent: checklist P-2(i) treats consent as "expected in connection with payoff." APA 7.1(d)(i) makes it a separate condition (Credit Agreement 9/8/2021, consent needed for sale of substantially all assets). If payoff at Closing moots it, obtain a written Buyer waiver (11.5) or a consent clause in the payoff letter.
C3 HIGH Crestline consent: APA 7.1(d)(ii)/Sched. 7.1(d) item 2 requires 75% member consent under s. 8.4 of the Second Amended and Restated LLC Agreement (3/1/2019); Novak holds 72%, so Crestline's 28% is indispensable. Checklist calls it the "Amended and Restated" agreement and says consent is only "being prepared"; APA 4.2 already represents it was obtained - a rep exposed if it was not. Obtain signed consent before Closing; it must also be in the Seller Secretary's Certificate (8.1(g)(i)), which checklist S-6 omits.
C4 CRITICAL Estoppel certificates omitted: APA 7.1(f) (condition) and 8.1(k): from landlords under Assigned Real Property Leases (Burnham/Portland). Not in checklist. Add.
C5 CRITICAL FIRPTA Certificate omitted: APA 7.1(h), 8.1(f) (Treas. Reg. 1.1445-2(b)(2)). Add as Seller deliverable; failure triggers withholding exposure.
C6 CRITICAL Title insurance commitments: APA 8.1(l) requires Seller to deliver Cascadia commitments for Hillsboro (1195 NE Cornell Road) in satisfactory form; checklist P-6 treats it only as a title search ordered by Buyer's counsel with a report "awaited," and no seller deliverable. Convert to deliverable; review exceptions against Permitted Encumbrances.
C7 HIGH Burnham/Portland Lease date mismatch: checklist P-2(iii) "Commercial Lease Agreement dated September 1, 2019"; APA Sched. 7.1(d) item 4 "Lease Agreement dated February 14, 2018" (s. 17.2 consent not unreasonably withheld). Verify the operative lease and amendments before drafting the consent/estoppel.
C8 MEDIUM Aeromet litigation (P-8): checklist cites 7.1(g) as an Aeromet-injunction condition; 7.1(g) covers Orders of, or Actions by, Governmental Authorities only (an Aeromet injunction would be an Order, but a pending private suit is not a failure). 2.4(d) Excluded Liability cite is correct. Add bring-down of Schedule 4.10 (discovery stage; filed ~9/6/2024) to Seller's certificate.
C9 LOW HSR (P-1): consistent with APA 6.3/7.1(d)(v)/7.2(d); filing 3/21 met the 7-Business-Day requirement (3/25).

D. SELLER DELIVERABLES
D1 HIGH Good standing: checklist S-7 requires Oregon only; APA 8.1(h) requires Oregon and Washington within 10 Business Days of Closing (earliest 5/1/2025). Add Washington.
D2 HIGH Bill of Sale (S-1): checklist says it conveys all "Acquired Assets"; APA 8.1(a)/Ex. A cover tangible personal property only. Also no deed is listed anywhere for Hillsboro (2.1(e)) and the Assignment (S-2) omits Assigned Real Property Leases (8.1(b)); APA itself has no deed deliverable - add a deed and lease assignment (gap in APA too). Checklist uses "Acquired Assets" rather than the APA defined term "Purchased Assets."
D3 CRITICAL Non-Competition (S-5): checklist 3 years, expiring 5/15/2028; APA 8.1(e)/Ex. E four years, expiring 5/15/2029. Checklist adds customer/employee non-solicits not in APA summary (and omits the 2% passive-ownership carve-out); 7.1(e) is a general deliverables condition, not a stand-alone one. Correct term.
D4 CRITICAL TSA (S-4, B-3, PC-6): checklist $50,000/month, $300,000 total; APA 8.1(d)/Ex. D $45,000/month, $270,000. Services differ (checklist adds CRM transition; APA lists IT, financial reporting, HR/payroll transition, vendor management). Monthly-payment timing is not in APA. Overcharge $30,000. Term (6 months, 11/15/2025) matches.
D5 HIGH Secretary's Certificate (S-6): omits Crestline consent in resolutions; describes LLC Agreement as "Amended and Restated" (APA: Second); APA 8.1(g) requires only organizational documents "as in effect on Closing Date" and dating as of Closing.
D6 HIGH Payoff letter (S-8): APA 8.1(i) also requires releases of deeds of trust (Hillsboro) and "other release documentation"; checklist covers UCC-3 only. Add mortgage reconveyance.
D7 MEDIUM Seller's Closing Certificate (S-10): APA 8.1(m) certifies only 7.1(a), (b), (c); checklist expands to all 7.1 conditions and names Novak as "Managing Member" (APA: Manager). Align or Seller will resist.
D8 LOW Part I states excluded items generally; no checklist coverage of Tigard Warehouse Lease, Novak Engineering consulting agreement (related party) or Cessna N472CN (2.2(d),(f)); add exclusion confirmations.

E. BUYER DELIVERABLES
E1 MEDIUM Escrow Agreement (B-4): checklist says "among Buyer, Seller, Escrow Agent ... executed by Buyer"; APA 8.2(e) lists execution by Buyer and Escrow Agent while 1.1 defines it as among all three. Reconcile and obtain Seller signature; fix amount/period (A1, A5); cite Article IX not X.
E2 MEDIUM Buyer's Closing Certificate (B-7): APA 8.2(h) certifies 7.2(a)-(b) only; checklist references all of 7.2, and limits signers to Ellsworth/Hu (APA: authorized officer). Align.
E3 LOW B-5/B-6 consistent with 8.2(f)-(g) (Secretary or other authorized officer; Delaware; 10 Business Days). Amounts in B-1 corrected per A1-A2.

F. EMPLOYEE AND LIABILITY ITEMS
F1 HIGH Cross-reference errors: checklist cites 6.1 for employee offers (APA 6.1 is conduct of business; employees are 6.8); PTO as 2.3(c) (APA 2.3(d); 2.3(c) is warranty); indemnification as "Article X" (APA Article IX); 7.1(g) for Aeromet; 9.1(b)/9.1(d). Correct all.
F2 MEDIUM PTO: $387,000 is stated "as of date hereof" and adjusts to Closing balances (2.3(d)); APA 4.12(b) states it for all employees. Checklist should confirm it is excluded from NWC to avoid double counting (unresolved; Schedule 1.1(b) not supplied).
F3 MEDIUM Benefits: PC-5 says "substantially comparable" but omits APA 6.8(b) "in the aggregate," bonus opportunity, and 6.8(d) no-third-party-beneficiary. WARN: PC-5 says Seller remains responsible; APA 6.8(c) splits Seller (pre-Closing actions) and Buyer (post-Closing actions); at-risk group is about 19 non-hired employees.

G. MISSING POST-CLOSING ITEMS
G1 MEDIUM Add: purchase price allocation (Buyer within 90 days after final NWC determination; Seller 30 days to object; IRC 1060) 6.7(b); tax proration 6.7(c); 7-year records retention 6.7(a); Direct Claim 30-day deemed-acceptance and Third-Party Claim 30-day assumption windows 9.6; Tax rep survival; Fundamental Representations list (4.1, 4.2, 4.4, 4.11, 4.14).

H. DOCUMENT INCONSISTENCIES (RED FLAGS)
H1 CRITICAL Buyer name: APA cover, signature block and email domain (dhu@vanguardindustrial.com) show "Vanguard Industrial Holdings, Inc."; preamble and checklist say Saxonbrook. Confirm exact legal entity before closing; correct by 11.5 amendment, since Secretary's Certificate, Delaware good standing and wires depend on it.
H2 HIGH APA dated 3/14/2025 recites the 3/21 HSR filing and 4/8 early termination (6.3), impossible at signing; indicates the circulated APA is a post-signing revision. Confirm the executed version and any amendment; if the checklist is built from the wrong version, many deviations above may be version errors.
H3 MEDIUM Exhibits A-F are not attached (summaries only) and Schedules 1.1(a)/(b), 4.1, 4.7, etc. are absent; "Action," "GAAP," "Representatives," "Indemnifying Party" are undefined.

RECOMMENDED NEXT STEPS
(1) Today: issue offer letters (4/30 deadline). (2) Reissue checklist corrected to the APA. (3) Add Northwind, estoppels, FIRPTA, Washington good standing, title commitments, deed and lease assignment. (4) Reconcile the Buyer name and the executed APA version. (5) Correct Escrow Agreement, TSA and Non-Compete drafts. (6) Resolve 2.5(b)(iii)/2.6(e) holdback conflict. (7) Re-docket 7/14/2025, 11/15/2026, 5/15/2029.
